sentences.text: Facts in brief, germane, are as follows:

The petitioner is said to be the owner of the land bearing survey Nos.75/5, 75/6 and 75/4, totally measuring 5615.01 sq. mtrs., situated at Sheshagiri Halli, Bidadi Hobli,
Ramanagara District.

The lands belonging to the petitioner become the subject matter of acquisition for the purpose of formation of National Highway and is acquired by the National Highways Authority of India on certain compensation.
On 23.09.2016, a final notification is issued and the lands are acquired, pursuant to which, on 01.02.2017, the second respondent - Special Land Acquisition Officer is said to have passed an award.
Being aggrieved by the said award, it transpires that the petitioner files an appeal before the Deputy Commissioner and Arbitrator under the National Highways Act, 1956.

The Deputy Commissioner is said to have heard the matter and reserved for orders on the application on 08.08.2024, close to an year NC: 2025:KHC:19753 HC-KAR has passed by and the fate of this petitioner is marooned in thin air, due to the inaction of the Deputy Commissioner in not passing necessary orders in accordance with law on the application so filed by the petitioner.
4.
In the light of the aforesaid facts and the prayer being innocuous, no notice to respondent Nos.2 and 3 need be issued.

5. For the aforesaid facts and reasons, I deem it appropriate to dispose the petition by issuance of a writ in the nature of mandamus, directing the first respondent - Deputy Commissioner to pronounce the order on the application, so reserved on 08.08.2024, within an outer limit of two weeks from the date of receipt of a copy of this order.
Accordingly, writ petition is allowed.

Sd/-
